role: The bed: a two-half block the player right clicks to sleep (setting spawn and passing the night), with a head-foot pair kept in sync and half-height bounds.

members.name: BlockBed
members.note: Entry 26: hardness 0.2, bounds to 0.5625, render type 14.

members.name: field_149981_a
members.note: Ported as a function; activate.c:158 and blockcb.c:320 carry the same table.

members.name: getSelectedBoundingBoxFromPool
members.note: The selection box is the bed bounds (0.5625 high) the pick and the outline read.

members.name: getIcon
members.note: The bed's part textures resolve inside the renderer.

members.name: getIcon
members.note: The item-form and inventory icon; the mesh scenes compare the bed halves, the block-icon goldens the item.

members.name: registerBlockIcons
members.note: Atlas naming only.

members.note: false.

members.note: 14; render_blocks3.c:1 names it.

members.name: getItem
members.note: pick block (Minecraft.func_147112_ai)

members.name: func_149895_l
members.note: meta & 3 at render_blocks3.c:374; inherited from BlockDirectional.

members.name: func_149975_b
members.note: The head bit, meta & 8, at render_blocks3.c:375.

members.name: func_149976_c
members.note: The occupied bit (meta & 4) read by onBlockActivated's occupied branch inside sleep_bed_activate; surv2-bed-s1 sleeps and wakes.

members.name: func_149977_a
members.note: World.doesBlockHaveSolidTopSurface through place_solid_top_surface (stair bit 4, slab bit 8, hopper, full snow layer); EntityPlayer.verifyRespawnCoordinates (survival.c verify_respawn) and both wakes (sleep.c) call it. bed-safe-tops-s1 wakes and respawns on a top slab, an upside-down stair, a hopper and a full snow layer, then finds nothing over a 6/8 layer.

members.name: func_149979_a
members.note: The occupied bit as a flag-4 metadata write (sleep.c:184).

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: The live server's copy in sleep.c (activate.c:bed_activate is the probe's). Outside the overworld: the head goes (the foot pops through onNeighborBlockChange with its bed drop), the cell past the head is cleared if it is a bed, and tnt.c:tnt_replay_blast runs newExplosion(null, 5.0F, true, true) on that cell in the player's world. bed-boom-s1 uses a bed in the Nether.

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: blockcb.c pops a half whose partner is gone (the foot drops the bed item); surv2-bed-s1 and bed-boom-s1.

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: BlockBed.java declares no breakBlock (Block's empty body runs); the partner half goes through onNeighborBlockChange (blockcb.c).

members.name: onBlockHarvested
members.note: Its body acts only in creative mode (the head half removes the foot); survival breaks leave it to onNeighborBlockChange.

members.name: dropBlockAsItemWithChance
members.note: The head half drops nothing, the foot the bed item (drops.c, blockcb.c).

notes: surv2-bed-s1 exercises the sleep machine end to end (the S0A and S0B packets, the occupied bit, the spawn set). The dig-region copy of breakBlock is in dig.c's bed case (dig.c:26, ids.bed at dig.c:81). lane/idxblocks: reviewed member by member; nothing survival reaches is left. Since lane/endreturn (2026-09-27): a bed used in the End blows up over the End's lists, so the blast reaches the dragon's parts and the crystals (tnt.c tnt_replay_blast through serverreplay_end_run_blast), end-bed-s42 (three beds, the first beside the dragon's head). lane/beds: the refusals (day, a zombie near, a slime near is no refusal, too far, a stale occupied bit), the wakes by damage and by the broken bed, the respawns at and away from the bed and the thunder sleep each have a recording (bed-*-s1).
